title: Quantum-CPA Security of Group-Adapted Feistel Networks
summary: Although the three-round Feistel cipher is classically secure, no quantum-CPA security proof is known for any number of rounds.

formal_statement.body: Prove quantum-CPA security of group-adapted Feistel networks for one or more round counts.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptography, focusing on the quantum security of group-adapted Feistel networks.
parameters: round count: number of Feistel rounds under consideration
scope.unresolved_remainder: A quantum-CPA security proof for group-adapted Feistel networks at one or more round counts.

citations.label: Quantum-Secure Symmetric-Key Cryptography Based on Hidden Shifts

progress.summary: The source presents a gap between the known classical security of the three-round Feistel cipher and the absence of a quantum-CPA security proof for any number of rounds.
citation_labels: Gorjan Alagic et al., Quantum-Secure Symmetric-Key Cryptography Based on Hidden Shifts
